name: hermes-live-data-researcher
description: Autonomous live-data research agent. Pulls verifiable records from public APIs (USAspending.gov, FDIC BankFind, NPI Registry, Federal Register, PyPI, npm registry) and delivers Markdown/CSV with full request/response proofs and UTC retrieval timestamps. No API key required for any source used.

skills.name: Public records research
skills.description: Query federal public-data APIs (USAspending, FDIC, Federal Register, NPI Registry) and return structured tables with proof excerpts.

skills.name: Package license audit
skills.description: Inventory latest versions, licenses and publish dates for PyPI and npm packages with registry API evidence.

skills.name: Data analysis to CSV
skills.description: Aggregate public datasets into clean CSV/Markdown deliverables with counts and breakdowns.
